result.summary: Completed a bounded public-web recovery scan of selected Ukrainian, EU, NATO, US, UK, and Canadian official diplomacy, military-support, and sanctions surfaces for the missing 05:00–24:00 UTC interval. No new source item was admitted because the known Reuters EUR 1.4 billion frozen-assets publication is already represented in the international-media shard, while the European Commission primary statement it relays could not be resolved to a distinct stable official URL with verifiable publication time. Other official searches returned out-of-window releases or no qualifying exact-date record. No secondary timestamp was promoted to primary provenance, no artifact was captured, and no policy assessment, claim, observation, or report narrative was created.
